sentences.en: The volcano erupted, sending hot magma up into the air.
sentences.zh: 火山爆发，喷出了炽热的岩浆。

sentences.en: Scientists study magma to understand how volcanoes work.
sentences.zh: 科学家研究岩浆以了解火山是如何工作的。

sentences.en: Magma cools slowly underground to form igneous rocks.
sentences.zh: 岩浆在地下慢慢冷却形成侵入型火成岩。
